images.title: Adding triangles to a circle for a half turn and a quarter turn
images.purpose: Show the worked example: a circle with one triangle above it, then the same design with a triangle added below for a 1/2 turn, then with triangles added on the left and right for a 1/4 turn.
images.composition: Three panels in one row, each with a caption under it; the added shapes are amber and the first shapes are teal.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. Three panels in one row. Each panel is a rounded rectangle 380 wide and 400 tall with a thin dark #2B2B2B outline and a white fill, at x 60 to 440, 538 to 918 and 1016 to 1396, all at y 190 to 590, with the centre of the design at the centre of the panel (x 250, 728 and 1206; y 390). The design in every panel is built from a circle of 70 px across, teal #0072B2, at the centre, and triangles each 70 px wide at the flat side and 70 px tall, with the flat side touching the circle and the point away from it. PANEL 1: the teal circle and one teal triangle above it, pointing up. PANEL 2: the same circle and the same teal triangle above, and one amber #E69F00 triangle added below the circle, pointing down. PANEL 3: the same circle with the teal triangle above and the amber triangle below, and two more amber triangles added, one on the left of the circle pointing left and one on the right pointing right. Under the panels, centred on each at y 650, a caption in dark #1F2937 sans-serif (40 px): Start, Added for a 1/2 turn, Added for a 1/4 turn. In all there are exactly 3 circles and 1 plus 2 plus 4 equals 7 triangles drawn in the frame, 1 in panel 1, 2 in panel 2 and 4 in panel 3. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
a different number of triangles in any panel
triangles that are not the same size
images.takeaway: To make a design look the same after a turn, copy each part to the place where it would land.
images.description: A circle with a triangle above it, the same with a triangle added below, and the same with triangles added on the left and right, the added triangles in amber.
images.context: Concept image for the first teaching concept, A Design That Looks the Same After a Turn. It uses the plan's own circle and triangles (practice values), not the book's design.
images.teaching_notes: Ask where the top triangle lands after a 1/2 turn and after a 1/4 turn. The slip to watch: adding only one triangle for the 1/4 turn.

image_decisions.why: The three stages of the design make the worked example visible: one copy added for a half turn, two more for a quarter turn.
